out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT AT HOME PESTICIDE CANNOT BE USED AT THE FACILITY AND ESPECIALLY NOT IN THE KITCHEN. PIC THREW AWAY HOME PEST CONTROL CHEMICALS.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: raw shell eggs on cart next to stove top were being stored in ambient temperature higher than 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS HAS DISCUSSED ISSUE WITH PIC ON MULTIPLE VISITS. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO KEEP EGGS AT AN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 45F OR BELOW. PIC MOVED EGGS TO THE 3DR PREP TOP UNIT TO COOL TO 45F.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. EHS OBSERVED MULTIPLE DRINKING CUPS WITHOUT LIDS IN THE FOOD PREP AREAS.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT OPEN CUPS CANNOT BE IN FOOD PREP AREAS AND MUST ALWAYS HAVE LIDS AND STRAWS FOR THE CUPS. PIC REMOVED THE DUPS FROM THE FOOD PREP AREA AND THREW THEM AWAY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR WERE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT BEAN SPROUTS AND CUT VEGETABLES.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOODS CANNOT BE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED THE EGGS TO A LOWER SHELF, BELOW ALL READY TO EAT FOODS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MINCED GARLIC (71F), COOKED EGG ROLLS (58F) WERE NOT COLD HOLDING AT RHE CORRECT TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL FOODS THAT ARE BEING COLD HELD MUST BE 41F OR BELOW TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL OF BACTERIA GROWTH. PIC THREW AWAY THE MINCED GARLIC AND EGG ROLLS.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: EGGS WERE BEING STORED IN A CONTAINER NEAR THE GRILL WHERE THE AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WAS MUCH HIGHER THAN 45 DEGREES.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT EGGS MUST BE COLD HELD AT THE AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 45F OR BELOW. PIC MOVED EGGS TO PREP TOP COOLER TO PROPERLY COOL TO 45F OR LOWER.
